base.note: v9 train set verbatim (100 instruction rows with context + 69 intent rows, including the 6 thanks paraphrases)

replay.source: Darwin, On the Origin of Species, First Edition 1859, public domain, recorded in data/expanded/SOURCES.md (entry: 'Origin, First Edition 1859, 949,182 chars, sha256 dd09b437…'). On-disk file is 934,492 bytes; the SOURCES.md char count differs (staging count), recorded here for transparency.
replay.note: continuous narrative prose sampled from the body of the Origin only — NOT dictionary entries, NOT math prose. v10's replay was mostly fragmented Webster's dictionary definitions at 24%; v12 tests a genuinely different replay hypothesis: plain narrative at ~10%.
replay.framing: instruction = 'Continue the following passage.\n\n' + first half of a corpus chunk; response = second half; source = 'replay-corpus'
replay.split: near midpoint at a sentence boundary ('. ') in the middle third of the chunk; nearest space fallback

val.note: pinned 8 val rows, UNCHANGED (sha256 verified identical before/after this build)

screening.rule: two standards (same as build_v10_data.py). All rows: no train instruction may equal (normalized) any probe or val instruction; no probe question may appear as a phrase in any row; no heldout_text.txt line/sentence (>= 30 chars) may appear in any row. Replay rows additionally: the full v8 screening (val questions as phrases, >=70% of a probe/val question's content words).
screening.result: all 188 rows pass — no probe wording, no val instruction as a train instruction, no heldout_text.txt overlap

training.recipe: v9 exact settings: rank 16, alpha 32, targets q,k,v,o, LR 2e-4, AdamW, constant LR, 12 epochs, batch 2, grad-accum 2, seed 42, --save-every 25, from the BASE model. Single-factor change vs v9: the data mixture only (plain-narrative replay at ~10%). LR stays 2e-4 — NOT combined with v11's LR 1e-4.
